unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Lines and planes in space
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: Theorem 1. Through a line and a point not on it there passes a plane, and only one.
stages.headlineEnglish: Theorem 1. Through a line and a point not on it there passes a plane, and only one.

stages.headline: Theorem 2. Through two intersecting lines there passes exactly one plane; the same holds for two parallel lines.
stages.headlineEnglish: Theorem 2. Through two intersecting lines there passes exactly one plane; the same holds for two parallel lines.

stages.headline: Everyday example: a door turns about the hinge line, and the lock (a point off that line) fixes it in one position.
